The sound wave following tapping a tuning fork looks something like this (although the oscillation is much faster than shown):

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: C13-dmkmy
fork <- function(t) {
  ifelse(t < 2, 
         0,
        (pnorm(t, mean=2, sd=0.4) - pnorm(t, mean = 10, sd=5)) * sin(2*pi*t/0.5))
}

slice_plot(fork(t) ~ t, domain(t = 0:20), npts = 1000 )
```

The tuning-fork function shown is different from any of the core modeling functions. Pick the core modeling function that is most similar and explain how the tuning-fork function differs from it.

`r devoirs::devoirs_text("RQ8-4ys")`


:::
